criteria.reason: Correctly affirms communes (and cantons) can restrict fireworks within higher law; says Bund mostly not directly needed.
Ties specifics to cantonal law and communal rules; no invented Lucerne articles, though LSV mislabelled as 'Gesetz' and 'Fürsorgebehörde' confused.
Rich concrete local steps: written inquiry, Gemeinderat proposal, petition, Tierschutz cooperation, campaigns, canton escalation, legal remedies.
Takes no side on the initiative but never mentions it or its 29 November 2026 ballot.

summary: Substantively correct on communal competence with detailed concrete steps; neutral but entirely silent on the national fireworks initiative; minor legal naming slips.
